statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The overnight tape is two-sided and orderly inside a narrow range after a record Nvidia-led close; the concentrated scheduled risk is a stacked 14:00 UTC catalyst set on Friday.
recommendation: Tail remains below the caution threshold for the current overnight hour. A narrow elevated window is published for 13:45-18:00 UTC on 28 August, covering the U.S. cash open, Chicago PMI, the Fed Chair keynote, the preliminary payrolls benchmark revision and a possible delayed second leg.
headline: Two-sided overnight range holds after a record Nvidia-led close; narrow elevated window flagged around Friday's stacked 14:00 UTC catalysts
body: The Nasdaq-100 closed at 29,641.56, up 417.04 points (+1.43%) and effectively on the session high of 29,643.53, after Nvidia rose 8.74% on its quarterly report. Breadth behind that headline was narrow: only 156 of 503 S&P 500 members advanced and the Dow added 0.20%, so leadership was megacap and software concentrated. VIX fell 4.60% to 14.51. Treasury yields remain elevated, with the 2-year at 4.19% and the 10-year at 4.66% on the latest H.15 data for 26 August. WTI trades near $83.39 and Brent near $88.49, both marginally lower, with the Strait of Hormuz situation still unresolved. In the current 00:00 UTC hour NQ trades near 29,627.25, about 0.23% below the prior settlement, inside a two-sided overnight range of 29,592.00 to 29,656.00. The index has already retraced back through the middle of that range after trading its low, so pullbacks are working, no session extreme is being held and no persistent one-way structure is present. Asia is mixed, with the Nikkei 225 up 0.19% and the Kospi down 1.16%. Delayed cross-asset context agrees: index futures are marginally lower, the VIX future is near unchanged and Treasury futures are flat, so there is no amplifier stack. Current Tail is therefore low while Stress stays elevated on narrow breadth, a thin volatility cushion, tight rates and a firm crude complex. The dominant forward risk is a dense scheduled stack on Friday. Chicago PMI prints at 13:45 UTC, and at 14:00 UTC three items land together: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote, the final Michigan sentiment release including inflation expectations, and the BLS preliminary annual benchmark revision to nonfarm payrolls, whose prior revision was -911K. Fed funds futures imply roughly a 64% probability of a September hold and the last meeting produced three dissents, so policy direction is genuinely contested. A first keynote is also structurally multi-stage - prepared text, delivery, curve repricing, then a possible delayed equity second leg - and that delayed leg is the specific path that denies mean reversion. The forecast therefore lifts Tail into the elevated band for a narrow window rather than across the whole session.

lookbackSummary: Across the 24 clock hours from 00:00 to 23:00 UTC on 27 August the published assessment stayed green throughout, with Tail between 10 and 14 and Stress oscillating between the mid-40s and mid-50s. Mode was event/whipsaw in the first hours around the Nvidia release, then predominantly mixed, with trend-up reads at 17:00 and 20:00 UTC as the Nvidia-led advance carried the index to a close on the session high. Two clock hours, 00:00 and 09:00 UTC, have no published assessment and are marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The remaining overnight and Asian hours are expected to stay range-bound with Tail in the low band and Stress easing toward the high-40s. Both then build progressively through the European morning into the U.S. session. The elevated segment is deliberately narrow: 13:45-18:00 UTC spans the cash open, Chicago PMI, and the simultaneous 14:00 UTC arrival of the Warsh keynote, final Michigan sentiment and the preliminary payrolls benchmark revision, plus the delayed second leg a multi-stage policy event can produce. Tail peaks at 28 in the two hours around that stack, mapping to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES, then decays back below the caution threshold into the U.S. close on the base case that price discovery proves orderly and retracements return.
